output.brief:
The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Only 7.4.0 can have the flag, and 7.4.0 was already crashing at about 2% on 2–3 Sep, before the ramp. 7.3.2 stayed at about 0.7% throughout. Within 7.4.0, flag-on users crash at 2.10% against 1.98% for the random holdout. That 0.12-point difference is within noise. Device mix and usage are the same across the groups. The top 7.4.0 crash cluster (41%) is a native image-library crash (Pixelda 3.1 HEIF decoding) that doesn't exist in 7.3.2. The app-store console, which is independent of the crash SDK, shows the same gap, so it isn't a reporting artifact. A small flag effect of a few tenths of a point can't be ruled out yet. I'm fairly confident in this, though flag-linked memory kills remain slightly open.
Next steps:
- Don't ship 7.4.0 to 100%. Hold it at 25% and fix the Pixelda crash.
- Don't treat the incident as resolved by turning the flag off, because that would leave the real cause in place.
- Keep the existing holdout running, and widen it if you want an answer sooner.
- Keep the current crash SDK, because rolling it back would hide crashes rather than fix them.
